title: The recruiting calendar
objectives: Place each step of a summer internship cycle on a calendar, from postings in July to offers in winter.

screens.prose: Summer 2028 feels far away. Most of its steps happen in 2027. Place each step where you think it falls.

state.caption: Month 0 is July 2026. Drag each step to where it falls for a **summer 2028** internship.

screens.question: Drag the five steps onto the calendar for summer 2028.

hints.text: Large firms post their summer internships about a year ahead.
The internship itself is June to August 2028, months 23 to 25.
Apply in July 2027 (month 12), test soon after, interviews in September, offers in November, internship in July 2028.

feedback.correct: The whole cycle runs about a year before the summer it is for.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Most steps for summer 2028 happen in the second half of 2027.

byKey.apply: You put Apply too late. Postings for summer 2028 open about July 2027, a year ahead.
byKey.test: The online test comes days or weeks after you apply, so it sits just after Apply.
byKey.inter: Interviews follow the test, through the autumn of 2027.
byKey.offer: Most offers land between late October and mid-December, months 15.9 to 17.5.
byKey.intern: The internship is the summer of 2028: June to August, months 23 to 25.

explain.text: Summer 2028 postings open around July and August 2027, with rolling review. Offers land from late October to mid-December 2027, and the internship runs in summer 2028. Sources: QuantVault internship timeline 2027 and Quantt UK guide to quant internships, 2026, as reported.

screens.prose: You just placed one **recruiting cycle**. Postings open about a year ahead, with **rolling review**: applications read as they arrive. Offers land from late October to mid-December, with one- to two-week deadlines. Here is the summer 2027 cycle against today.

state.caption: Sources: QuantVault internship timeline 2027 and Quantt UK guide to quant internships, 2026, as reported.

screens.question: As of today, 2 November 2026, where is the summer 2027 cycle?

options.text: Offers are landing; most applications have closed or are closing
Applications are just opening
options.why: You started the cycle in November. Summer 2027 postings opened in July and August 2026.

options.text: It is over
options.why: You ended it too soon. Offers run to mid-December, and rolling roles stay open until filled.

options.text: The internships are running
options.why: Those run in summer 2027, months 11 to 13.5.

hints.text: Find the Today point.
Which window does it sit in?
Today sits in the offers window. The application window was July to October.

feedback.correct: Offers are landing now. Summer 2027 is the opportunistic cycle.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Find the window that holds Today.

explain.text: Today sits inside the summer 2027 offers window. Most large-firm applications opened in July and August 2026 and have closed or are closing. So summer 2027 is the cycle you apply to opportunistically.

screens.prose: A UK **spring week** or insight day is a short, usually paid programme in March or April. Applications open in late August or September; most close in December or early January. It often leads to a fast track to summer interviews.

state.caption: Sources: Warwick Business School spring week guide; the-trackr; both 2026.

screens.question: Who is a spring week for?

options.text: First-years of a three-year degree, or second-years of a four-year one
Penultimate-year students applying for summer
options.why: You gave it to the summer internship group. Spring weeks come a year earlier.

options.text: Final-year students looking for a job
options.why: You gave it to graduates. Spring weeks are for students two years from the end.

options.text: Anyone at any stage
options.why: You skipped the eligibility rule. Firms set the year of study, and they check it.

hints.text: A spring week is two years before graduation.
Count back from the final year.
Three-year degree: the first year. Four-year degree: the second year.

feedback.correct: The year that is two years from graduation.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Count back two years from the final year.

explain.text: Spring weeks are for students two years from graduation: the first year of three, or the second of four. They often, not always, fast-track you to summer interviews. Sources: Warwick Business School blog and the-trackr, 2026.

screens.prose: An **off-cycle internship** runs outside the summer, typically 3 to 6 months. These are official 2027 London examples.

rows: Quantitative Finance Associate Off Cycle Internship Programme 2027
Closed 30 Sep 2026; penultimate or final year, or recent graduate

state.caption: Postings live October 2026, from the firms' careers pages and targetjobs.co.uk. Check each posting before acting.

screens.question: Select all that apply: who does an off-cycle internship suit?

options.text: A student on a year out
A Master's student after the taught part of the course
Someone who missed the summer cycle
A first-year who wants a one-week taster
options.why: You wanted a spring week. Off-cycle roles are months long.

options.text: A student with lectures and exams that term
options.why: You ignored the length. Three to six months full time clashes with term.

hints.text: How long does an off-cycle role last?
3 to 6 months, outside the summer.
It suits anyone free for months outside the summer. Think of a year out, a Master's, or a missed cycle.

feedback.correct: Anyone free for months outside the summer.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Ask who can work full time for 3 to 6 months outside the summer.

explain.text: An off-cycle role needs 3 to 6 months free outside the summer. That fits a year out, a Master's student after the taught part, or anyone who missed the summer. Deadlines pass too: the global bank's role closed on 30 September 2026.

screens.prose: Count from today, 2 November 2026. One date has already gone: a third-party guide said one bank's 2027 London routes close on 1 November 2026.

state.caption: Deadlines as checked by QuantVault against official pages on 21 October 2026. Check the firm's own page before acting.

screens.question: Fill in the days left.

hints.text: Finish November first: 28 days to 30 November.
Then add the days into December, and December's 31 for January.

feedback.generic: Not quite right. Count the rest of November, then whole months, then the days into the last month.

byKey.r3c2: Check the market maker's row. Count 28 days to 30 November, then 6 into December; do not count today.
byKey.r4c2: Check the January row. Count 28 days in November, all 31 of December, then 3.

explain.text: November has 28 days left after the 2nd. So 6 December is 28 + 6 = 34 days away, and 3 January 28 + 31 + 3 = 62. Dates pass: the bank's reported date went yesterday.

screens.prose: A posting closes on 30 November and reviews applications on a rolling basis. Your CV is ready on 4 November.
screens.question: When should you apply?

options.text: As soon as the CV is ready, in the first week
On 29 November, after more polishing
options.why: You aimed at the closing date. Under rolling review places can be gone by then.

options.text: After 30 November, if places remain
options.why: You aimed past the deadline. The posting will be closed.

options.text: When the firm emails a reminder
options.why: You waited for the firm. A reminder may never come, and places fill meanwhile.

hints.text: What does rolling review mean?
Applications are read as they arrive.
Interviews go to early applicants while places last. Apply as soon as the CV is ready.

feedback.correct: Early, because places fill before the date.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Under rolling review, earlier is better.

explain.text: Rolling review reads applications as they arrive and fills places as it goes. The closing date is the last moment, not the target. Apply in the first week.

screens.prose: The same posting: closes 30 November, rolling review, your CV ready on 4 November.
screens.question: Drag Apply to the day you will send the application.

hints.text: Is the closing date the target?
Your CV is ready here.
Send it within a few days of the CV being ready: day 2 to 5.

feedback.correct: Within days of the CV being ready.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Apply soon after the CV is ready.

byKey.deadline: You dragged Apply to the closing date. Under rolling review places fill before it, so the deadline is the last moment, not the aim.
byKey.apply: Move Apply closer to the day the CV is ready.

explain.text: The deadline is the last day a firm will read anything, not the day to aim for. Under rolling review the early applications get the interviews. Send it within days of the CV being ready.

screens.prose: Degree length shifts everything. Amir starts a one-year MSc in September 2027 and wants a summer 2028 internship.
screens.question: When should Amir apply?

options.text: From July 2027, as postings open, and no later than his first weeks
In January 2028, after his first exams
options.why: You waited to settle in. By January most summer 2028 offers have been made.

options.text: In June 2028, when the course ends
options.why: You waited for the end of the course. The internship would already be under way.

options.text: He cannot; summer 2028 is inside his course
options.why: You ruled him out. Many one-year MSc students intern in the summer; check the course allows it.

hints.text: Where does the MSc start sit against the windows?
The applications window opens in July 2027, before he arrives.
He applies as postings open in July 2027, and no later than his first weeks in September.

feedback.correct: As postings open, and no later than his first weeks.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Compare his start date with the applications window.

explain.text: The MSc starts inside the applications window, which opens in July 2027. He can apply as postings open, and no later than his first weeks. Work from your graduation date: in a four-year MMath the third year is the penultimate one.

screens.prose: The US cycle, for comparison. It also opens long before the summer, but dates differ by firm and move each year. One trading firm's first-year programme ran in New York on 23 to 27 March 2026. Its London run was 7 to 11 April 2026.

rows: Trading firms often July and August; many banks months earlier, as reported

state.caption: Sources: QuantVault and Quantt timelines; that firm's programme pages; bank dates from careers press; 2026. Check each firm's careers page.

screens.question: What carries over from the UK cycle to the US one?

options.text: The rule: apply as soon as postings open
The label "spring week"
options.why: You carried over a UK name. US firms call them first- and second-year programmes.

options.text: Pay quoted in pounds a year
options.why: You carried over the UK unit. US pay is quoted in dollars by the hour or week.

options.text: The main internship in the final year
options.why: You moved the main internship. In both, it comes the summer before the final year.

hints.text: Compare the first row.
Read the first row: in both, postings open long before the summer itself.
The rule transfers: apply as soon as postings open. The labels and the pay units do not.

feedback.correct: The rule transfers; the labels do not.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Look for a habit that holds in both columns, not a label.

explain.text: Both cycles open long before the summer, and some US postings, banks above all, open well before July. The US names its early programmes differently and quotes pay in dollars by the hour or week. Lead with the UK cycle, and check US dates on each firm's page.

screens.prose: From today, 2 November 2026, to 1 July 2027 is 241 days. You write your own calendar in homework 1.
screens.question: How many full weeks is that?

hints.text: Divide by 7.
241 = 238 + 3, so 34 full weeks and 3 days.

feedback.generic: Not quite right. Divide 241 by 7 and keep the whole part.

byKey.old: That counts from 29 October. From 2 November it is 34 full weeks.
byKey.round: That is 34.4 weeks. Give the full weeks: 34.

explain.text: $241 = 7 \times 34 + 3$, so 34 full weeks and 3 days. As a check, 2 November plus 238 days is 28 June 2027, three days before 1 July. You write your own calendar in homework 1.

ideas: A summer cycle runs a year ahead: postings in July and August, rolling review, offers late October to mid-December.
Spring weeks are for students two years from graduation; off-cycle roles last 3 to 6 months outside the summer.
Under rolling review, apply as soon as you are ready. Count days from today, and dates pass.

formula.name: Days to a deadline
formula.tex: \text{days} = \text{rest of this month} + \text{whole months} + \text{days into the last}

summary.trap: The deadline is the last day, not the target. Under rolling review the places fill first.

quiz.prose: Zoe is in the second year of a four-year MMath.
quiz.question: Which programme fits her this cycle?

options.text: A spring week
A penultimate-year summer internship
options.why: You counted from her year number. Her penultimate year is next year, the third.

options.text: A graduate job
options.why: She has two more years to go.

feedback.correct: A spring week: she is two years from graduation.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Count back from her final year.

explain.text: A four-year degree ends in year four, so year three is penultimate. Year two is two years out, the spring-week year.

options.text: As soon as your application is ready
In the final week, once it is perfect
options.why: Under rolling review, places can be gone before the last week.

options.text: On the closing date
options.why: The closing date is the last moment, not the target.

feedback.correct: As soon as it is ready.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. Rolling review fills places as it goes.

explain.text: Rolling review reads applications as they arrive and gives places out as it goes. Early applications see more open places.

quiz.question: When do most large-firm summer internship offers land in the UK cycle?

options.text: Late October to mid-December of the year before the internship
In the spring just before the internship
options.why: You placed offers months too late. The cycle runs about a year ahead.

options.text: Straight after the internship ends
options.why: You confused offers with return offers.

feedback.correct: Late October to mid-December, the year before.
feedback.generic: Not quite right. The cycle runs a year ahead.

explain.text: Postings open in July and August, and interviews run through the autumn. Most offers land from late October to mid-December (Quantt guide, 2026).
